g.text: IN PLAIN ENGLISH

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Add the duration of each beat to locate the output in clock time.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Subtract the common reference and convert seconds to milliseconds.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Multiply elapsed seconds by the sample rate to locate its audio frame.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: T: clock seconds; beta_j: bar j's start beat; B: BPM along the song.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: T0: song start; t_ref: reference origin; f_s: frames/second; round: nearest integer.

g.text: WORKED RAP EXAMPLE

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: First 4 beats at 90 BPM: 4 x 60/90 = 2.667 s.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Next 4 beats at 120 BPM: 4 x 60/120 = 2.000 s.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: T0 = t_ref = 0. Next output starts at beat 8.

g.text: A tempo edit changes future playback times. The lyric can stay the same while its target audio positions change.
